_comment: Which tier each test is reported under, and what each promotion stage runs. scripts/test-tiers.py reads tiers; test/ci (TestTiersPartitionPackages, TestEveryCIJobHasAStage) checks both against the module and the workflows. A test lands in the first tier whose rule matches it: tests names a test-name pattern in any package, packages a package pattern (relative to the module, or test/sdk/go) for every test in it.

pull_request.plan: computes the selection: cmd/affected over the files the pull request changes
pull_request.unit: every package, each read from main's result cache unless its inputs changed
pull_request.race: the affected packages, -race -short (internal/racegate skips single-goroutine large-input tests)
pull_request.fuzz: the targets in the affected packages
pull_request.mutation: the mutants on changed files, of changed tests, or whose entries changed (internal/mutation select_test.go)
pull_request.image: when cmd/mirror, a Dockerfile or a profile changes
pull_request.generated-models: when specs, internal/generated or cmd/mirrorgen change
pull_request.cloudflare-miniflare: when internal/execution, test/behavior/cloudflare or tools/cloudflare-runtime change
pull_request.test: fails unless every required job passed or was skipped as unaffected

main.unit: every package, writing the result cache pull requests read
main.test: fails unless every required job passed
